summary: Coinbase has a public Builders landing page, but I could not verify a current Base Camp accelerator cohort, application deadline, program dates, or cadence from public sources. The page now points builders to Coinbase Developer Platform products, OnchainKit, Base, and grants/resources rather than a dated accelerator application.
